values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/haakwood ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Haakwood State Forest Campground: 18 campsites, $20, managed by Burt Lake SP), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in river access down a short footpath from the south-end parking lot; the Rondo Public Access Site is beside the entrance.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/haakwood ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'There is a small parking lot on the south end of the campground and a short footpath that leads down to the river', 'or at the Rondo Public Access Site adjacent to the campground entrance'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/haakwood ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Haakwood State Forest Campground: 18 campsites, $20, managed by Burt Lake SP: Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 18 spacious, wooded sites 'for tent, small trailer and large trailer use' in three small loops. No length limit posted.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/haakwood ('The campground is separated into three small loops. The campsites at Haakwood are spacious, wooded', 'There are 18 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (18 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the Sturgeon River (the Lower Peninsula's fastest river, a trout stream), 2 mi N of Wolverine via South Straits Highway (Cheboygan County); managed by Burt Lake State Park. A reviewer fit a 22-ft rig into site 1. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 18 sites for tent, small and large trailer, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed, now manual). Season (early Nov - late April closure) already manual. Phone 231-238-9392 matches (Burt Lake SP). Note trimmed of field restatements and 'sites are smallish' (DNR: 'spacious').
